entries.note: genesis: free local Tier 1 audit front door; zero network enforced by a socket guard in the audit process and in the scorer-probe subprocess, not asserted in prose

from the first run on a real 103-file project: collapse repeated not-run lines to one per reason, tighten the scorer-candidate filter so validators and test helpers are counted as ruled out rather than reported as scorers, and add the single recommended next step the brief requires

independent tools-on review found the zero-network claim false on 5 of 8 escape routes: shrink the claim to what is enforced, add a preflighted network-namespace sandbox for the probe, close _socket and the ssl-breaking guard, refuse a non-deterministic --scorer, stop relaying exception and stderr text, and turn every silent cap into a printed finding

second review round: classify a module named at runtime as executing and stop presenting the classifier as a boundary, read only the probe's own framed result line through a typed whitelist so a scorer cannot forge a verdict, and bind the project back into the sandbox so a project under /tmp is not reported as a broken scorer

add the approval-gated second tier (scripts/tier2_checks.py): offer mode prints one approval card per applicable check under the same network guard Tier 1 installs and makes no request and spawns no process; run mode touches only the approved checks' named endpoints and writes a receipt the tests compare byte-for-byte against a real listener's log. Transport is X-API-Key plus the SDK's own User-Agent, proven against that listener; the key never reaches a card, a receipt, a command line or an error, and a response echoing it is withheld. Ships the shared economics reference by pointer

after a cross-vendor consult and a customer dogfood run: example-scoring becomes a READER (summary, then dataset-quality only on computed:true) because the compute endpoint returned HTTP 500 and a successful read establishes neither its availability nor a charging boundary; `computed:false` is relayed as not computed and never as permission to POST. Replace the 'what settles it' promises with what the services actually do -- retrieve a verdict if they have one -- and state that a completed run is necessary and not sufficient, with each card carrying what the same check returned on our own run. Add stop-here as a recommendable card so no run is ever recommended merely to make an analysis service answer. Disclose the key header on every card, and keep the agent's own pre-approval interaction-profile fetch out of Tier 1. Run discovery lists project/experiment/run context and auto-selects nothing, names the listing limit, and says a local session id 404s. Document the origin-vs-/api/v1 base-URL split and refuse a base URL carrying a path; relay the plan's evidence_level and objectives orientation verbatim with the advisory-steps warning
